github.pr.checks.read.json_fields: OPTION A: statusCheckRollup (nested array; validate shape). OPTION B: bucket, completedAt, description, event, link, name, startedAt, state, workflow
github.pr.checks.read.recommendation_text: Use option A: gh pr view --json statusCheckRollup. gh pr checks has documented additional exit code 8 = 'Checks pending', which collides with the Broker global non-zero = failure semantics; a single CLI command should not force binding-specific exit handling. gh pr view always exits 0 on successful read regardless of pending checks, and statusCheckRollup carries the same check states. Option B (gh pr checks) is acceptable ONLY if the binding documents binding-specific exit semantics for exit 8 and the Broker exception is explicit.

option_a.exit_semantics: 0 = read success (pending checks still exit 0); 1 = failure; 4 = auth required
option_a.notes: statusCheckRollup is a nested array: [{name, status, conclusion, startedAt, completedAt, detailsUrl, checkSuite, ...}] per local gh 2.97.0 --help; adapter must pin gh >= 2.97.0 and validate the nested shape

option_b.json_fields: bucket, completedAt, description, event, link, name, startedAt, state, workflow
option_b.json_mode_semantics: --json adds a bucket field categorizing state into pass|fail|pending|skipping|cancel (documented in local --help)
option_b.exit_semantics: 0 = all checks passed; 1 = failure; 2 = cancelled; 4 = auth required; 8 = checks pending (command-specific additional exit code)

github.pr.checks.read.expected_success_exit: A: 0 (always on successful read). B: 0 only when no pending checks; 8 while pending.
github.pr.checks.read.special_exit_semantics: B has command-specific exit 8 = 'Checks pending' that breaks uniform non-zero = failure; B's --watch mode loops until checks finish (never use in adapter); B without --json prints terminal-width-truncated table (never parse plain output)
